dedupe_keys.name: sample input data and supporting files for the select model of urbanization

description: The IM3 project archives sample inputs and supporting files for the SELECT long-term urbanisation model. Zenodo lists one public 2.79 GB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The linked repository says SELECT projects urban fraction by decade from 2010 to 2100 at one-eighth-degree resolution, with downscaling to 1 km; this input release includes a sample SSP5 run. Urban fraction scenarios can inform future building, transport and utility-demand simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this sample input bundle. A limitation is that other SSPs require additional prepared inputs. The repository says its AUTO-SELECT workflow requires Windows, a licensed ArcGIS Spatial installation and more than 200 GB of working space, and has hardcoded relative paths; the data archive itself is open but execution has separate costs and practical constraints. The ZIP was not downloaded, and its geographic completeness, input dates and output maps were not checked. No SELECT run was attempted.
